name: trance-signal-before-dawn
brief: Signal Before Dawn. Holding on through the long stretch before dawn. Not a party song: a 3am promise, one voice against a big sky. Uplifting trance at 138 BPM in A minor. The breakdown is the emotional centre and the drop is the earned payoff. Lyrics come from the existing human-authored sheet, not from the planner.
title: Signal Before Dawn
